structured.test_code:
from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

import calibration_target

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


@pytest.mark.verifies("TREQ_CALIBRATION_SUMMARY[revision==1]")
def test_secret_absent_from_summary_when_level_is_zero() -> None:
    """The secret must never appear in summary, even when level is 0."""
    record = calibration_target.Record(
        name="weather_model",
        secret="api_key_xyz789",
        level=0,
    )
    result = record.summary()
    assert "secret" not in result, (
        f"summary() must never expose 'secret', but got: {result!r}"
    )
